title: Preserve app-owned state during import refresh
decision: SG-0007 import refresh should preserve app-owned state such as audit/ledger.jsonl, approved workbook-state sidecars, draft workbook state, and runtime data. The importer may seed missing workbook sidecars non-destructively, but normal import refresh must not overwrite existing approved or draft workbook state or reset audit/runtime data.
context: SG-0007 refreshes the app-facing EPP workspace before SG-0013. The refresh needs to clean imported content, metadata, sources, and extracted context without destroying local review history, workbook progress, or runtime state that belongs to Archivist rather than the source import.
rationale: Import refresh should be repeatable and safe to run during development and later local use. Treating it as a destructive reset would make review history and workbook work fragile.
alternatives_considered: Wipe and reseed all workspace state on every import refresh
Preserve only the audit ledger while reseeding workbook state
Require manual backups before running import refresh
consequences: SG-0007 should replace imported content, sanitized project metadata, retained regulatory sources, and scoped extracted context without clearing app-owned state
Existing audit/ledger.jsonl, workbook-state, draft workbook state, and runtime data should survive normal import refresh
Missing workbook sidecars may be created only when absent and should be reported separately from overwritten imported surfaces
A future explicit reset command can handle destructive workspace resets if that workflow becomes necessary
